result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned with adjacent cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the middle card ('Smash Bros Burgers') is shifted downward compared to the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards on either side, breaking the top alignment of the row.
issues.suggestion: Remove any unexpected top margin or padding on the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card and ensure all items in the carousel container share consistent vertical alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start).
